applicable_when: The kernel stores to out_ptr0[x0 + 512*x1] where x0 = xindex % 64. With XBLOCK=128, consecutive threads write to addresses 512 floats (2048 bytes) apart — a stride-512 scatter that is maximally non-coalesced. This causes 53.3% of all warp cycles to stall on L1TEX scoreboard waits and keeps L1 hit rate at only 31.09%. The output tensor has strides (100352, 1, 7168, 512): the innermost channel dimension (stride=1) IS contiguous in the output, but the kernel iterates in input-linear order and scatters. The fix is to iterate in output-linear order so stores become fully coalesced (stride-1 writes), and instead gather from the strided input.
